translations.web: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he who loves abundance, with increase: this also is vanity.
translations.bsb: He who loves money is never satisfied by money, and he who loves wealth is never satisfied by income. This too is futile.
translations.kjv: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
